text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, my? Could this perhaps be... what they 
call a skin breakout?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It seems my new skincare products 
didn't agree with me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll refrain from using it for now and 
leave the rest to my body's natural 
healing ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after, Yamanin Zephyr remained 
concerned about her rough skin.
